title: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stand 26-Inch Solid Brass | Allied Brass
short_title: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stand 26-Inch | Allied Brass
description:
Add flexible storage without drilling with this freestanding toilet tissue stand, crafted from solid brass with a heavy base for stability. A felt pad helps protect floors, making it a practical fit for modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories, especially where wall space is limited.

Highlights:
- Freestanding design requires no wall mounting; ideal when wall space is at a premium
- Solid brass construction for enduring everyday use
- Heavy solid brass base helps resist tipping
- Felt pad helps prevent scratching on most surfaces
- Available in a wide variety of designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs:
- Type: Freestanding toilet tissue stand
- Material: Brass
- Dimensions: 6-Inch W x 5.5-Inch L x 26-Inch H
- Weight: 4.8 lb
- Assembly required: Yes
- Included: Toilet tissue stand
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
